title: Inspire Science: Integrated, Grade 7 (Write-In Student Edition, Units 1-4)
edition: 2020 (copyright 2020 on the publisher page; ISBN records say 2019)

sources.what: publisher scope and sequence (units, modules, lessons)
publisher product page for Unit 1 (ISBN 9780076874538, copyright 2020)
Bookshare record confirming Unit 1 title 'Understanding Matter'

summary: An NGSS-built integrated middle-school science course in four write-in unit books organised into modules and 5E lessons. Grade 7 covers the particle nature of matter and chemical change, plate tectonics and natural hazards, Earth's resources and synthetic materials, and energy and matter in ecosystems.

toc.label: Unit 1
toc.title: Understanding Matter
toc.covers: The particle model of matter, states and changes of state, and physical and chemical changes.

children.label: Module
children.title: Classification and States of Matter
children.covers: How particles behave in each state and how temperature and pressure change them.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Energy and States of Matter
children.covers: Particle motion in solids, liquids, and gases and the energy involved in melting, freezing, boiling, and condensing.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Changes in Temperature
children.covers: How adding or removing thermal energy changes particle speed and temperature.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Changes in Pressure
children.covers: How gas pressure, volume, and temperature relate.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Molecular Structure
children.covers: Atoms, elements, molecules, and models of simple and extended structures.

children.label: Module
children.title: Matter: Properties and Changes
children.covers: Physical and chemical properties and what happens to matter and energy in chemical reactions.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Properties of Matter
children.covers: Physical and chemical properties such as density, melting point, and reactivity used to identify substances.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Property Changes in Chemical Reactions
children.covers: Evidence of chemical change, reactants and products, and conservation of mass.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Energy Changes in Chemical Reactions
children.covers: Exothermic and endothermic reactions and devices that release or absorb thermal energy.

toc.label: Unit 2
toc.title: The Changing Earth
toc.covers: Plate tectonics and the processes that build and wear down Earth's surface, plus earthquakes, volcanoes, and severe weather.

children.label: Module
children.title: Dynamic Earth
children.covers: Evidence for moving plates and how internal and surface processes reshape Earth.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Moving Continents
children.covers: Wegener's continental drift and its fossil, rock, and climate evidence.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Development of a Theory
children.covers: Seafloor spreading and how it led to the theory of plate tectonics.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Shaping Earth's Surface
children.covers: Plate boundaries and the mountains, trenches, and rift valleys they form over geologic time.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Changing Earth's Surface
children.covers: Weathering, erosion, and deposition by water, wind, and ice.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: The Cycling of Earth's Materials
children.covers: The rock cycle driven by Earth's internal heat and the sun.

children.label: Module
children.title: Natural Hazards
children.covers: Causes, prediction, and reducing the impact of natural hazards.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Earthquakes
children.covers: Faults, seismic waves, earthquake locations, and safety measures.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Volcanoes
children.covers: How volcanoes form, eruption types, and monitoring.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Severe Weather
children.covers: Thunderstorms, tornadoes, hurricanes, and forecasting and preparedness.

toc.label: Unit 3
toc.title: Earth's Resources
toc.covers: Where natural resources come from, why they are unevenly distributed, and how people make and use synthetic materials.

children.label: Module
children.title: Distribution of Earth's Resources
children.covers: Renewable and nonrenewable resources, their geologic origins, and their depletion.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Natural Resources
children.covers: Minerals, fossil fuels, soil, water, and renewable vs nonrenewable resources.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Distribution of Resources
children.covers: How past geologic processes left resources unevenly spread across Earth.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Depletion of Resources
children.covers: How population growth and consumption use up resources, and conservation.

children.label: Module
children.title: Materials Science
children.covers: Synthetic materials made from natural resources and their effects on society.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Synthetic Technology
children.covers: How chemical processes turn natural resources into materials such as plastics, fuels, and medicines.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Impacts of Synthetic Materials
children.covers: Benefits and environmental costs of synthetic materials.

toc.label: Unit 4
toc.title: Interactions Within Ecosystems
toc.covers: How matter and energy move through ecosystems, how organisms interact, and why biodiversity matters.

children.label: Module
children.title: Matter and Energy in Ecosystems
children.covers: Photosynthesis, respiration, food webs, and the cycling of matter.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Photosynthesis and Cellular Respiration
children.covers: How producers store light energy in sugar and how organisms release it.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Flow of Energy
children.covers: Food chains, food webs, and energy pyramids.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Cycling of Matter
children.covers: Carbon, nitrogen, and water cycles and the role of decomposers.

children.label: Module
children.title: Dynamic Ecosystems
children.covers: Resources, interactions among organisms, and how ecosystems change.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Resources in Ecosystems
children.covers: Limiting factors and how resource availability affects populations.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Interactions Within Ecosystems
children.covers: Competition, predation, and symbiotic relationships.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Changing Ecosystems
children.covers: Disturbances and ecological succession.

children.label: Module
children.title: Biodiversity in Ecosystems
children.covers: The value of biodiversity and ways to protect it.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Benefits of Biodiversity
children.covers: Ecosystem services and why varied ecosystems are healthier.

children.label: Lesson
children.title: Maintaining Biodiversity
children.covers: Threats to biodiversity and evaluating solutions to conserve it.

notes: Headings are from the publisher's scope and sequence, which lists units, modules, and lessons without numbers. In that PDF the Grade 7 and Grade 8 columns are interleaved; units were assigned by column position in the layout text. Unit 1 is ISBN 9780076874538 (confirmed on the product page); 9780076874545 is presumably Unit 2. Modules nest under units and lessons under modules.
